assertions.rule: Every durable event kind resolves to its registered component and state-resolution family without prose inference.

Every or_set component declares bottom as inert or expose, never reject, and an or_set bottom is never dispatched as an authorization rejection. inert is the default because the or_set join cannot produce bottom; expose is legal only for a cell family whose owning domain document defines the exposed multi-head handling. See zh/authz/event-auth-state-resolution.md section 9.1.1.
Every referenced lattice or state-machine family has a registered reducer semantic.
Unknown component, lattice family, or critical dispatch metadata is rejected before state mutation.
